intro: From a blank canvas to an HTTP endpoint, in five steps.
outro: Self-hosted. Built on LangGraph, FastAPI and React Flow.
drag: Drag an LLM and a Human node from the palette
wire: Select the old edge, press <kbd>Del</kbd>, then wire Start → LLM → Human → End
prompt: Write the prompt. {{state.message}} reads the run input
output: In the Data tab: add a reply field and write the answer to it
human: The Human node asks before the reply goes out
channel: Send the request to Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, e-mail or Teams too
remote: Approvers can answer there: buttons in chat, links in e-mail and Teams
save: Save. Every save is a new version
input: Run it with a JSON input
wait: The run stops at the Human node, with its state checkpointed
diff: Each step keeps its input, output and state diff
token: Create a token for the service that will call it
curl: That service starts a run over HTTP: 202 queued
cron: Or run it on a cron schedule, in its own time zone
history: History lists both runs. The API run waits for approval
agent: New: the Agent node. Start from the Support agent template
tools: The model picks among the tools you allow. <b2>Needs approval</b2> guards one
agentWait: The refund call waits for a person, like a Human node
rounds: The trace shows each round: the model call, then the tool it chose
travel: <b2>Time travel</b2>: open a checkpoint, edit its state, fork a new run
mcp: Serve the workflow as an MCP tool to Cursor, Claude Desktop or Claude Code
phone: On a phone, the editor shows one pane at a time
